verdict.rationale: NVIDIA docs explicitly confirm low-precision Tensor Core support (FP4, FP8, FP6, BF16, FP16, TF32) on the Blackwell/RTX 50-series architecture used by the 5090, which covers the precision-format half of the story. However, none of the evidence documents specific LLM serving-stack support (TensorRT-LLM, vLLM, llama.cpp) for this exact card, and ROCm is not applicable to an NVIDIA GPU at all. Missing for 10: explicit TensorRT-LLM/vLLM/llama.cpp compatibility documentation for RTX 5090, independent benchmarks confirming inference throughput with these stacks.
